::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** May 1854  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown.  Printed in <i>[Dulce Domum](other_books/otherbook_122.qmd)</i> 111-2.
:::

My dear [Alice](people/person_1025.qmd),
[I](people/person_1606.qmd) wrote instantly to thank [Dr. Moberly](people/person_1015.qmd) for his good news, but the cart was missed on Sunday morning.  Tell us if [Margaret](people/person_83.qmd) has seen [the brother](people/person_1026.qmd)[^1], and what she said of him, and tell us who the boy is like and whether he is large or small, dark or fair.  Three days of well-doing make us think you will soon be ready for ‘[Heartsease](cmy_books/cmybook_19.qmd)’;  there will be plenty for you to begin upon.  I am bent upon Charlotte seeing all she can of [Bishop Selwyn](people/person_1295.qmd), and trust to Dr. Moberly to manage it for her, and must have her see [Mrs. Selwyn](people/person_1297.qmd) somehow.

---

[^1]: Selwyn William Moberly (1854-1871), seventh son and youngest of the Moberlys' fifteen children, was christened on 8 June 1854.
